move.title: Move 20 strategies into a 150-strategy library
move.about: Moving local work to the cloud while the library is open at the top level, half the strategies into a folder. Each move is createWithInitialPage, getShell, two pages:add, two applyBatch (75 items), getFullSnapshot and finishMove, with the folder tree and the top-level list live. Oct 22: every move write re-ran both lists, each re-run reading the whole library (#388).

agentDrag.title: Drag an agent
agentDrag.about: One element.patch of an agent's position through ops:applyBatch, on a page of 60 items watched in slices, with the library lists live behind the editor. Oct 19: the drag re-read every agent of the strategy to rebuild its agent summary (75 KB, #348).

sliceEdit.title: Edit a page watched in slices
sliceEdit.about: One item moved on a page of 60 items that the editor watches as page:getFrame plus four page:getElementSlice ranges (#350). The edit should re-run the one slice holding the item: 17.4 KB per save in slices against 56.5 KB for the whole page when slices shipped.

concurrentEdits.title: Two devices edit one strategy at once
concurrentEdits.about: Two signed-in devices each send 10 single-drag applyBatch calls to the same strategy at the same time, on different items of one page. Oct 22: a per-strategy counter row made concurrent batches lose write conflicts and retry (#391's design).
